settings.title: Public profile
settings.intro: A portfolio with numbers PulseStage verifies: sessions delivered, people reached and the audience rating. Schools, universities and companies find you in the <link>speaker directory</link> and send you speaking requests.
settings.liveListed: It shows up in the directory and can be found by search engines.
settings.liveUnlisted: It's not in the directory yet: you need one verified session. Anyone with the link can already see it.
settings.verifiedDescription: Ended sessions count when at least {responders} people responded and the talk lasted {minutes} minutes. These numbers can't be edited.
settings.ratingPending: Shows up after {min} survey responses (you have {count}).
settings.ratingHidden: Hidden on your profile (see the options below).
settings.dataDescription: Your name, photo and short bio come from <link>Account</link>.
settings.nameMissing: Add your name in Account before publishing your profile.
settings.sessionsDescription: Check the verified sessions you want on your profile (title, date, audience size and rating). Every verified session counts toward your numbers, checked or not; sessions that don't meet the criteria only show up here.
settings.emptyDescription: Once you end a session, it shows up here.

form.publishHint: Anyone with the link can see your profile. Once you have at least one verified session, it also shows up in the speaker directory.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing the address breaks any links you've already shared.
form.headline: Professional headline
form.headlinePlaceholder: E.g., Engineering professor and speaker on AI in education
form.topicsPlaceholder: E.g., Artificial intelligence, Leadership, Personal finance
form.topicsHint: Separate with commas. Up to {max} topics; each one gets its own page in the directory.
form.experiencePlaceholder: E.g., Talks at Conference X (2024), training for Company Y, graduate classes at School Z.
form.experienceHint: What you've done outside PulseStage. It's shown apart from your verified numbers and labeled “self-reported”.
form.contactEnabled: Get speaking requests through your profile
form.contactEnabledHint: Shows the “Invite to speak” button. Requests arrive in Speaking requests; your email stays hidden.
form.showRatingsHint: Average of the 0–10 questions (usefulness, satisfaction and recommendation) from your verified sessions.
form.promoteOnSurvey: Promote your profile after the survey
form.promoteOnSurveyHint: People who answer the survey for one of your sessions see a “Meet the speaker” card with a link to your profile.

share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.

invites.title: Speaking requests
invites.intro: Requests sent by schools, universities and companies through the “Invite to speak” button on your public profile. They don't see your email: you reply whenever you want.
invites.notReceivingEnable: You're not getting speaking requests right now. <link>Turn on “Get speaking requests through your profile”</link> to get started.
invites.notReceivingPublish: You're not getting speaking requests right now. <link>Publish your profile</link> to get started.
invites.emptyInboxHint: When someone uses “Invite to speak” on your public profile, the request shows up here.
invites.deleteDescription: The request and the contact details will be deleted. This can't be undone.

public.metaDescription: {name}'s profile on PulseStage, with verified sessions and numbers.
public.noVerified: No verified sessions yet. The numbers show up here after the first session on PulseStage that meets the criteria below.
public.ratingLabel: audience rating (0 to 10), {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}
public.howBody: Only ended sessions that took place on PulseStage count, with at least {responders} different people responding and {minutes} minutes of presentation. The rating is the average of the 0–10 answers in the survey at the end of each session (usefulness, satisfaction and recommendation) and shows up after at least {ratings} ratings. Speakers can't edit these numbers; they can choose to hide the rating.
public.sessionsFootnote: Audience size based on the number of participants. Per-session rating with at least {min} responses.
public.experienceNote: Provided by the speaker; not verified by PulseStage.
public.inviteDescription: For universities, schools, companies and events. Your request goes straight to {name}.

directory.metaDescription: Find speakers for universities, schools, companies and events, with sessions and audience ratings verified by PulseStage.
directory.title: Speakers with a <mark>proven audience</mark>
directory.intro: Every number in this directory comes from real sessions on PulseStage: at least {responders} people responding and {minutes} minutes of presentation. Find someone for your class, school, company or event and send a speaking request through their profile.
directory.signupHint: Are you a speaker? <link>Create your account</link> and publish your profile after your first session.

topic.metaDescription: {topic} speakers for universities, schools, companies and events, with sessions verified by PulseStage.
topic.title: Speakers on <mark>{topic}</mark>
topic.intro: With sessions and audience ratings verified by PulseStage. Open a profile to see their sessions and send a speaking request.

directoryView.emptyNew: The directory is just getting started. Speakers show up here after their first verified session.
directoryView.emptyFiltered: Try another topic or remove a filter.

shell.tagline: PulseStage · live interaction for talks and classes

contact.sentBody: {name} will get your request and reply to the email you provided.
contact.name: Your name
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell them the topic, the audience, the format (in person or online) and the length.

errors.nameMissing: Add your name in Account before publishing your profile.
errors.slugTaken: That address is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.notReceiving: This speaker isn't accepting speaking requests through PulseStage.
errors.tooManyFromYou: You've sent several requests in a row. Try again in an hour.
errors.tooManyForSpeaker: This speaker has received a lot of requests today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.sendFailed: Couldn't send your request. Try again.
